note: CSS animations are in styles.css (their @keyframes are listed here too). `animations` says which element runs which; `scripted` are element.animate() calls with real keyframes; `players` are videos and Lottie/Rive players with the file they load; `recorded` are what the page's scripts wrote frame by frame while it loaded and was scrolled (one track per element and property, samples are [ms, value, scrollY]: replay them with the same timing); `classChanges` are classes scripts added or removed, with when and at what scroll; `films` are pictures of each moving thing over one cycle (look at them); `states` picture controls at rest, on hover and on focus; `scrollReveals` are elements the page's scripts watch as they scroll into view (their classes are as they ended up: write a small IntersectionObserver that adds the class the stylesheet keys on).
